title: Cloudflare Workers API – Delayed or Inconsistent Responses
summary: Cloudflare is investigating an issue affecting the Workers API and Workers configuration in the Cloudflare dashboard. Customers may see out-of-date or inconsistent information when viewing or managing Workers. For example, recent deployments or configuration changes may not show up right away. Workers that are already running in production are not affected. We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
